description: Pure enrichment module for supply_chain signal. Exposes compute_score(metadata: dict) returning (float 0-100, evidence dict). Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars. Pure function: same input always produces same output. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Completes in under 2 seconds. Evidence dict must list all fields used and partial scores derived. This is the primary supply_chain signal producer for mcp_signal_enrichments. Referenced explicitly in spec Section 3 signal model.
